content.short: In Upland, virtual properties match real street addresses, and players buy, sell and develop them as NFTs.
content.description: Upland launched in 2019 and lays a virtual map over real cities. Every parcel matches a real street address, and players buy, trade and build on these properties, complete neighbourhood collections and join city events. Partners have included the NFL Players Association and FIFA. Sparklet, the game's token, can be moved out to Ethereum and Base, and players have traded millions of dollars' worth of property with each other. Co-founders Dirk and Idan started the company in 2018, and the map now spans more than fifty real cities, from San Francisco to Tokyo, with millions of players and no resets since launch.
